tess_cs: Riverbend Health asks for a short APAC demo window tomorrow 09:15 SGT. Staging is hitting token and qps throttles. They want a 24h temporary qps increase + CIDR allowlist. Renewal review in 9 days so this demo is important.

noah_infra: Can you paste the CIDRs, exact window, preferred region, and model slug? We'll limit grant to the model.

tess_cs: Owner is emma@riverbend.health. Window: 2026-04-05T01:00Z -> 2026-04-06T01:00Z (24h). Peak ~1200 qps, steady ~600. CIDRs: 52.15.200.0/24 and 18.139.0.0/16. Region: ap-southeast-1 preferred. Model: rb/demo-core -> redwood/mini-v2-staging. They also want prefix caching for repeated prompts.

ops-bot: Ticket OPS-6590 created by @noah_infra: "Riverbend APAC demo temporary qps bump + CIDR allow". Approval SLA: 2h. https://redwood.ops/OPS-6590

noah_infra: Reserving a small burst pool and adding CIDRs to proxy allowlist. Ravi, can you pre-warm caches and bump concurrency to 14? Set batch_max_tokens=256.

ravi_se: Will do. Pre-warm top-6 prefixes, set concurrency=14, batch_max_tokens=256, prefix_cache TTL=450s. Spinning a warmed canary route now.

ops-bot: OPS-6590 status: Provisioned. CIDRs added (52.15.200.0/24, 18.139.0.0/16). Burst allocated in ap-southeast-1. Auto-revoke scheduled 2026-04-06T01:10Z.

noah_infra: Canary deployed, warm logs show kv_cache_hits=94%. Estimated uplift ~$420 for 24h. Limiting grant to model slug only.

tess_cs: Confirmed with customer: smoke passed at 09:05 SGT, main demo at 09:15 SGT succeeded. AE will note for renewal. Thanks team.

noah_infra: Closing OPS-6590 as complete; will revoke per schedule. Reach out if they need extension.

tess_cs: Marking as positive renewal signal. :smile:
